title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Opinions on Deepening the Comprehensive Supporting Reforms of the People's Courts' Judicial System — the Fifth Five-Year Reform Outline of the People's Courts (2019–2023)
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Opinions on Deepening the Comprehensive Supporting Reforms of the Judicial System of the People's Courts — the Fifth Five-Year Reform Outline of the People's Courts (2019-2023)

Fa Fa [2019] No. 8

To the Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Opinions on Deepening the Comprehensive Supporting Reforms of the Judicial System of the People's Courts of the Supreme People's Court have been approved by the Central Committee and are hereby issued for implementation as the Fifth Five-Year Reform Outline of the People's Courts (2019-2023). Please promptly report any major matters arising during implementation to this Court.

February 27, 2019

Opinions on Deepening the Comprehensive Supporting Reforms of the Judicial System of the People's Courts

— The Fifth Five-Year Reform Outline of the People's Courts (2019-2023)

Since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, under the strong leadership of the Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, the judicial system reform of the people's courts has been comprehensively and deeply advanced, achieving breakthrough progress in important areas and key links, and initially forming a socialist adjudicative power operation system with Chinese characteristics. The 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, from the perspective of developing socialist democratic politics and deepening the practice of governing the country according to law, made the important strategic deployment of deepening the comprehensive supporting reforms of the judicial system and fully implementing the judicial accountability system. The Organic Law of the People's Courts of the People's Republic of China, as amended and adopted at the Sixth Session of the Standing Committee of the 13th National People's Congress, further standardizes the organizational system, institutional setup, management system, team building, and performance guarantee of the people's courts, providing a legal basis for deepening judicial system reform and consolidating the achievements of judicial system reform at the legislative level.

To thoroughly implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's new concepts, thoughts, and strategies on comprehensively governing the country according to law, fully implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second and Third Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, and further deepen various reforms of the people's courts in the new era, these Opinions on Deepening the Comprehensive Supporting Reforms of the Judicial System of the People's Courts are hereby formulated, and will be implemented as the Fifth Five-Year Reform Outline of the People's Courts (2019-2023).

I. Overall Requirements

(1) Guiding Ideology

Guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, closely follow the changes in the principal contradiction in Chinese society, closely center on the overarching plan of coordinating the five-sphere integrated plan and the four-pronged comprehensive strategy, adhere to the people-centered development philosophy, adhere to the general principle of pursuing progress while ensuring stability, coordinate the advancement of various judicial system reform tasks deployed by the Central Committee, deepen the comprehensive supporting reforms of the judicial system of the people's courts in the new era at a higher position, deeper level, broader scope, and with greater strength, fully implement the judicial accountability system, accelerate the formation of a complete, scientific, standardized, and effective institutional system, promote the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics characterized by impartiality, efficiency, and authority to become more mature and well-defined, comprehensively enhance judicial capacity, judicial efficiency, and judicial credibility, promote the creation of a more favorable socialist rule of law environment, create a higher level of socialist judicial civilization, fulfill the responsibilities and tasks of maintaining national political security, ensuring overall social stability, promoting social fairness and justice, and ensuring the people's peaceful life, and strive to make the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case.

(2) Basic Principles

—— Adhere to the correct political direction. Firmly establish the "four consciousnesses," strengthen the "four matters of confidence," and resolutely achieve the "two upholds." Always adhere to the absolute leadership of the Party over the work of the people's courts, always ensure that judicial reform is carried out under the leadership of the Party, and give full play to the Party's leading core role in overseeing the overall situation and coordinating all parties, achieving the organic integration of Party leadership, the people being the masters of the country, and governing the country according to law.

—— Adhere to the people-centered approach. Always adhere to the purpose of serving justice for the people, firmly stand on the people's side, implement the mass line, and ensure that the judicial reform of the people's courts is always for the people, relies on the people, and benefits the people. Accurately grasp the contradiction between the people's growing needs for a better life and the unbalanced and inadequate development of judicial work, focus on solving the most concerned issues of public safety, rights protection, and fairness and justice, ensure that where the people call, reform responds, weave and tighten the judicial protection network for people's livelihood, and continuously enhance the people's sense of gain, happiness, and security.

—— Adhere to following the laws of justice. Accurately grasp the characteristics of adjudicative power as judgment power and its attribute as central authority, and improve supporting supervision and guarantee mechanisms that conform to the laws of adjudicative power operation. Always adhere to the unity of the problem-oriented and goal-oriented approach, promote the mutual promotion of pilot first and comprehensive advancement, adhere to using reform thinking and methods to solve problems in progress, further release potential, revitalize resources, and stimulate vitality through reform.

—— Adhere to serving and safeguarding the overall situation. Based on the judicial functions of the people's courts, correctly understand the overall situation, accurately grasp the overall situation, and fully serve the overall situation, firmly establish a new development concept, provide high-quality judicial services for promoting high-quality economic development, create a good legal environment for optimizing the business environment and promoting the formation of a new pattern of higher-level reform and opening up, and provide strong judicial guarantees for maintaining sustained and healthy economic development and overall social stability.

—— Adhere to promoting reform according to law and in an orderly manner. Adhere to the Constitution and laws as the basis, adhere to the system of people's congresses, ensure that the rule of law leads reform and reform improves the rule of law. When formulating reform plans, simultaneously study whether they comply with legal provisions and whether it is necessary to amend laws, ensuring that reform is based on the law. Major reform pilots requiring legal authorization shall be conducted strictly in accordance with legal procedures.

—— Adhere to strengthening system integration. Enhance the systemic, holistic, and coordinated nature of reform, while focusing on implementation, filling shortcomings, and strengthening weak points, also plan for the long term, solve difficulties, and overcome obstacles. Strengthen overall planning and overall advancement, clarify the overall relevance, hierarchical structure, and temporal sequence of various reform measures, ensure that reforms coordinate with each other in policy orientation, promote each other in implementation process, and complement each other in actual results, continuously improve the precision and refinement of reform.

—— Adhere to encouraging grassroots innovation. While giving play to the leading role of top-level design, also give play to the exploratory role of grassroots exploration, coordinate different regions for differentiated exploration, promote the benign interaction and organic combination of top-level design and grassroots exploration. Respect and protect grassroots initiative, improve the fault-tolerant mechanism, encourage grassroots exploration and practice, motivate grassroots to actively act, promote the elevation of beneficial experience into universal and long-term institutional design, and ensure reform is steady and enduring.

—— Adhere to strengthening technology-driven. Implement the strategy of strengthening the country through the internet, comprehensively build smart courts. Firmly grasp the historical opportunities of the new round of technological revolution, fully utilize modern technological means such as big data, cloud computing, and artificial intelligence to solve reform difficulties and enhance judicial efficiency, promote the joint efforts of judicial reform of the people's courts and intelligent and information construction, provide strong scientific and technological support for promoting the modernization of the trial system and trial capacity.

(3) Overall Objectives

—— Place the Party's political construction first, unify the implementation of Party policies with the enforcement of national laws, ensure that Party leadership and Party building lead the entire field of judicial reform of the people's courts and run through the entire process of judicial reform, promote the coverage of Party organization over the basic units of trial and execution work, and build a system for the people's courts to uphold Party leadership.

—— Adhere to centering on the central task and serving the overall situation, give full play to initiative, enthusiasm, and creativity, find entry points and focus points from a higher level and higher position, promote the deep integration of the work of the people's courts into the overall work of the Party and the country through lawfully performing functions and boldly reforming and innovating, and build a system for the people's courts to serve and safeguard the overall situation.

—— Take meeting the growing judicial needs of the people as the basic orientation of the work of the people's courts, strengthen the construction of the litigation service system, deepen the reform of the diversified dispute resolution mechanism, promote the placement of non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms at the forefront, improve the judicial assistance and litigation-related petition system, strive to make justice more people-friendly, litigation more convenient, and reform more beneficial to the people, and build a people-centered litigation service system.

—— Further deepen judicial transparency, continuously improve the four major platforms of trial process disclosure, trial activities disclosure, judgment documents disclosure, and enforcement information disclosure, comprehensively expand the breadth and depth of judicial transparency, improve the forms of judicial transparency, smooth channels for parties and lawyers to obtain judicial information, and build a more open, dynamic, transparent, and convenient sunshine judicial system.

—— Fully implement the judicial accountability system, improve the trial supervision and management mechanism and the mechanism for uniform application of law, improve the judicial performance guarantee mechanism and the accountability mechanism for illegal adjudication, ensure that judges concentrate on fulfilling their duties and handling cases, promote the realization that power must have responsibility, power must bear responsibility, dereliction of duty must be held accountable, and abuse of power must be pursued, and build a socialist adjudicative power operation system with Chinese characteristics centered on the judicial accountability system.

—— Optimize the functional positioning of the four levels of courts and the setting of trial levels, improve the organizational system of the people's courts adapted to the needs of national development strategies, deepen the reform of internal institutions of the people's courts, strengthen the construction of people's tribunals and professional trial mechanisms, improve the supporting mechanism for judicial funding guarantees, and build an optimized, collaborative, and efficient organizational system and institutional functional system of the people's courts.

—— Promote the reform of the civil and administrative litigation systems, deepen the reform of the trial-centered criminal procedure system, reform the mechanism for service of legal documents, promote the optimal allocation of trial resources and the comprehensive improvement of judicial efficiency, and build a litigation system that conforms to the progress of the times and technological development.

—— Comprehensively promote the informatization and standardization of enforcement, improve and perfect the comprehensive work pattern of solving enforcement difficulties, further advance the joint punishment of persons subject to enforcement for dishonesty, promote the improvement of the social credit system, protect the timely realization of the rights and interests of winning parties in law, promote the improvement and development of the socialist modernized enforcement system with Chinese characteristics, and build a long-term system for effectively solving enforcement difficulties.

—— Comprehensively promote the revolutionary, standardized, specialized, and professional construction of the people's court team, follow the laws of cadre growth, improve the mechanisms for judge training, selection, and education, strengthen the political training, knowledge updating, capacity training, and practical exercise of court officers, strive to improve the political quality, professional ethics, judicial ability, and professional level of the team, ensure that the functions of various personnel are clearly defined and occupational guarantees are in place, and build a system for classified management and occupational guarantee of court personnel under socialism with Chinese characteristics.

—— Comprehensively promote the construction of smart courts, promote the establishment of an inter-departmental big data case handling platform, promote the deep application of innovative technological means such as voice recognition, remote video, intelligent assistance, and electronic files, orderly expand the coverage of electronic litigation, promote the deep integration of trial methods, litigation systems, and internet technology, and build a socialist modern smart court application system with Chinese characteristics.

II. Main Tasks

(1) Improve the institutional system for the people's courts to uphold Party leadership

1. Comprehensively strengthen the absolute leadership of the Party over the work of the people's courts. Conscientiously implement the Regulations on the Political and Legal Work of the Communist Party of China, improve the working mechanism for upholding the Central Committee's authority and its centralized, unified leadership, strictly implement the provisions that the Party organizations of political and legal organs must report major matters to the Party committee. Strictly implement the main responsibility of the Party leadership groups of all levels of people's courts, improve and perfect the systems of the Party leadership group's responsibility list, rules of procedure, members of the Party leadership group participating in important business and important decisions in accordance with work procedures, and the supervision and feedback of major business work, ensure that the Party leadership group plays the role of guiding policy orientation, reform direction, and case handling orientation, and ensure that the Party's basic theory, basic line, and basic strategy are implemented without any discount in all work of the people's courts. Improve the mechanism for the people's courts to cooperate in participating in inspection tours, and effectively strengthen political supervision.

2. Comprehensively strengthen the Party building work of the people's courts. In accordance with the general requirements of Party building in the new era, take political construction as the guide, and continuously promote the Party building work of the people's courts. Strengthen the building of grassroots Party organizations in the people's courts, focus on improving organizational strength, highlight political functions, optimize organizational settings, strictly organize life, innovate activity methods, and give full play to the role of grassroots Party organizations as battle fortresses and the vanguard and exemplary role of Party members. Persist in grasping Party building, leading team building, and promoting adjudication, earnestly strengthen the political and business construction of trial and enforcement institutions, people's tribunals, and trial and execution teams, and enhance creativity, cohesion, and combat effectiveness.

3. Improve the working mechanism for Party political construction. Improve the theoretical education and political rotation training system for the people's courts, educate and guide court officers to deeply study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, ensure that they maintain a high degree of consistency with the Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core in political stance, political direction, political principles, and political path. Improve the supporting mechanism for promoting the deep integration of socialist core values into trial and execution work, ensure that the judicial interpretations, judicial policies, and adjudication rules of the people's courts play the function of value guidance, promote the use of rule of law thinking and rule of law methods to deepen reform, promote development, resolve conflicts, and maintain stability, make those who abide by the law and discipline proud, and make those who violate the law and lack morality unable to move. Adhere to guiding the construction of court culture with socialist core values, improve the cultivation mechanism of judicial professional spirit, and encourage court officers to firm their belief in the rule of law and be loyal to the judicial cause.

4. Implement the Party's organizational line in the new era. Adhere to taking political standards as the first standard, comprehensively strengthen political checks in the selection and appointment of judges, assessment and evaluation, supervision and management, training and exercise, rewards and punishments, etc. Strictly implement the principle of the Party managing cadres, in accordance with the requirements of political reliability, professional competence, responsibility, discipline, and work style, build a loyal, clean, responsible, high-quality, and professional court team. In light of the actual situation of the people's courts, establish systems for cadre quality cultivation, understanding people and recognizing talents, selection and appointment, strict management, and positive incentives, improve the working mechanism for discovering, cultivating, selecting, and appointing outstanding young cadres, and improve the working mechanism for motivating cadres to take responsibility and act.

5. Strengthen the construction of Party conduct and anti-corruption in the people's courts. Adhere to comprehensively governing the Party strictly, persistently correct conduct and discipline, unswervingly advance the anti-corruption struggle. Coordinate the deepening of comprehensive supporting reforms of the judicial system with the construction of Party conduct and anti-corruption, improve the risk prevention and control system for clean government adapted to the socialist adjudicative power operation system with Chinese characteristics, and ensure fair and clean justice. Improve the internal inspection, judicial inspection, and judicial affairs supervision systems, and integrate supervision forces. Strengthen the regular rotation and exchange of key positions. Improve the conflict of interest avoidance system for positions and powers, and standardize the contact and communication behavior between judges and parties, lawyers, special interested parties, and intermediary organizations.

(2) Improve the institutional system for the people's courts to serve and safeguard the overall situation

6. Improve the mechanism for providing judicial services and guarantees for fighting the three critical battles. Focus on resolutely fighting the three critical battles of preventing and defusing major risks, targeted poverty alleviation, and pollution prevention and control, strengthen trial guidance, improve working mechanisms, and create a good legal environment. Improve the risk monitoring and early warning mechanism in the field of financial adjudication, establish a big data resource database for financial cases, and improve the information sharing mechanism for financial risk prevention. Actively respond to the judicial needs in the supply-side structural reform of agriculture and the reform of the rural land system, and serve the implementation of the poverty alleviation and rural revitalization strategy. Adapt to the practical needs of the overall ecological protection of specific regions and river basins, improve the jurisdiction system for major environmental resources cases, and improve the connection mechanism between ecological environmental damage compensation and environmental public interest litigation. Explore the application of punitive damages in disputes over environmental pollution and ecological damage.

7. Improve the mechanism for providing judicial services and guarantees for major national development strategies. Actively innovate judicial coordination mechanisms, and provide stronger judicial services and guarantees for the coordinated development of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the construction of Xiongan New Area, the development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt, the construction of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and the construction of free trade zones. Improve the civil and commercial judicial assistance system with the Hong Kong and Macao Special Administrative Regions, and improve the mechanism for mutual recognition and enforcement of civil and commercial judgments. Support Hainan in comprehensively deepening reform and opening up, and provide strong judicial support for Hainan in building a free trade pilot zone and a free trade port.

8. Improve the mechanism for providing judicial services and guarantees for creating an international, rule-of-law-based, and convenient business environment. Cooperate with relevant central departments to study and formulate an implementation plan for building a rule-of-law business environment. Further optimize litigation services and procedural guarantees related to the performance of contracts and bankruptcy proceedings, explore the construction of a rule-of-law business environment evaluation index system that is both in line with China's national conditions and international standards, and gradually promote implementation in courts nationwide.

9. Improve the international commercial dispute resolution mechanism for the Belt and Road Initiative. Strengthen the construction of the International Commercial Court of the Supreme People's Court. Promote the active participation of mediation and arbitration institutions in the international commercial dispute resolution mechanism of the International Commercial Court of the Supreme People's Court, improve the "one-stop" international commercial dispute resolution platform that connects mediation, arbitration, and litigation. Improve the working mechanism of the International Commercial Expert Committee of the Supreme People's Court. Improve the mechanism for ascertaining foreign law. Promote the establishment of a network platform for service abroad.

10. Improve the supporting mechanism for judicial protection of property rights. Improve the property rights protection system with fairness as the core principle, study and improve policies on judicial protection of property rights, resolutely prevent the treatment of economic disputes as crimes, and resolutely prevent the conversion of civil liability into criminal liability. Promote the establishment of a coordination mechanism for property rights protection. Improve the normalized mechanism for legally identifying and correcting wrong cases involving enterprises, further strengthen the work of explaining the law through cases, and promptly publish representative typical cases.

11. Improve the judicial protection mechanism for intellectual property rights. Give full play to the leading role of judicial protection of intellectual property rights, and better serve the innovation-driven development strategy. Improve litigation systems such as case jurisdiction, evidence rules, and trial methods that are in line with the characteristics of intellectual property cases. Improve the intellectual property infringement compensation system. Strengthen the comprehensive and in-depth review of the legality of administrative acts of granting and confirming intellectual property rights and administrative law enforcement acts, and effectively promote the consistency of standards for granting and confirming intellectual property rights, administrative law enforcement standards, and judicial standards.

(3) Improve the people-centered litigation service system

12. Strengthen the construction of the litigation service system. Accelerate the modernization of litigation service centers, and strive to provide universal, equal, convenient, efficient, intelligent, and accurate litigation services. Improve the intensive litigation service mechanism of "one-stop online service" and "one-stop service offline". Introduce social third parties to participate in litigation service work, and enhance the level of socialization of litigation services. Generally promote the reform of the "diversion, mediation, expedited judgment, and fast trial" mechanism, improve corresponding information systems, and promote the timely and rapid resolution of disputes. Accelerate the reform of cross-regional case filing, promote the remote handling of litigation matters across regions and the joint handling across levels, and solve problems such as difficulty in filing cases in other places. Improve the convenient case filing mechanism combining on-site case filing, online case filing, self-service case filing, and cross-regional case filing services, to achieve litigation services that are "available nearby, available citywide, and available across regions". Promote the construction of smart litigation services, develop intelligent auxiliary software, and provide parties with services such as litigation risk assessment, pre-litigation mediation suggestions, self-service inquiry and consultation, and online handling of business, effectively reducing the litigation burden of the people.

13. Deepen reform of the diversified dispute resolution mechanism. Innovate and develop the "Fengqiao Experience" in the new era, improve the mechanism for "source governance of litigation," persistently prioritize non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms, and work to reduce the increase in litigation at its source. Improve the diversified dispute resolution system with organic linkage and mutual coordination among mediation, arbitration, administrative adjudication, administrative reconsideration, and litigation, and promote the construction of a social governance structure featuring collaboration, participation, and shared benefits. Strengthen guidance over industry-specific professional mediation work, improve mediation mechanisms involving multiple parties, refine the lawyer mediation mechanism, and further enhance the role of professional mediation. For cases that have a basis for mediation, improve the working mechanisms for pre-litigation mediation and entrusted mediation in accordance with the principles of voluntariness and legality, and guide and encourage parties to choose non-litigation methods to resolve disputes. Promote the establishment of a unified online platform for diversified resolution of conflicts and disputes, achieving online consultation, online assessment, online triage, online mediation, and online confirmation for dispute resolution. Promote judicial confirmation models combining online and offline methods to ensure that mediation results are fixed on the spot and conflicts and disputes are resolved locally.

14. Improve the judicial assistance system. Further study and refine regulations concerning the funding guarantee, scope of assistance, standard procedures, etc., for judicial assistance to enhance operability.

15. Deepen reform of the mechanism for handling litigation-related petitions. Further improve the working mechanism for separating litigation from petitions, and refine the mechanism for concluding and transferring litigation-related petitions. Strengthen the source governance of litigation-related petitions to protect the legitimate rights and interests of the people. Comprehensively promote the system of lawyer representation in申诉 (appeals/petitions). Improve the mechanism for the participation of third parties from society in resolving disputes, and enhance the combined force for resolving conflicts in litigation-related petitions. Raise the level of application of information technology in litigation-related petitions. Improve the system for petitions regarding enforcement, ensuring interconnection and interoperability with the online petition platform, the enforcement case handling system, and the national court litigation-related petition system, thus achieving normalized supervision over enforcement petition cases. Increase the intensity of sanctions against illegal petitioning acts, and promote the rational expression of demands in accordance with the law.

(IV) Improve the system of transparent judicial institutions that are open, dynamic, transparent, and convenient for the people.

16. Improve and perfect the working mechanism for judicial openness. Implement the principle of proactive, legal, comprehensive, timely, and substantive openness, adhere to the principle of "openness as the rule and non-openness as the exception," continuously broaden the scope of judicial openness, improve the forms of openness, smooth the channels of openness, strengthen platform construction, and enhance technical support. Deepen and advance the standardization, normalization, and informatization of information disclosure in areas such as judgment documents, court trial activities, trial processes, enforcement work, litigation services, judicial reform, and judicial administrative affairs. Improve and perfect the system of institutions for judicial openness, accurately delineate the standards for disclosure to the parties and disclosure to the public, study and issue relevant business guidance, technical standards, and operating procedures, and clarify the responsible entities for judicial openness. Strengthen the integration of the "four major platforms" for judicial openness, optimize platform functions, more prominently highlight the new characteristics of the mobile internet era, promote the transformation of platforms from one-way disclosure to multi-directional interaction, making litigation activities more transparent and litigation outcomes more predictable.

17. Deepen the public disclosure of trial process information. Strengthen the construction of the China Trial Process Information Disclosure Website, fully implement the provisions on disclosing trial process information through the internet, improve relevant business norms and technical standards, promote the automatic collection of data from online case handling, and promote the automatic and simultaneous disclosure of trial process information to case parties and litigation agents by courts nationwide through a unified platform.

18. Deepen the openness of court trial activities. Further improve the scope, procedures, and guarantee mechanisms for public trial hearings. Enhance the functions of the China Court Trial Online Website, expand the scope of public trial hearings, focus on cases with typical significance and high social attention, fully utilize forms such as live webcasts, video recordings, and图文 live broadcasts to achieve the normalization of open trials, actively accept social supervision, promote the enhancement of judicial capabilities, and carry out in-depth legal education.

19. Deepen the disclosure of judgment documents. Increase the intensity of comprehensive disclosure of judgment documents, strictly enforce the mechanism for approval of non-disclosure, and eliminate the problem of selective disclosure. Upgrade the China Judgments Online website, enhance the level of automation and intelligence in the technical processing of disclosed judgment documents, and focus on improving user experience. Strengthen the research and utilization of judgment document data resources, explore the establishment of long-term cooperation mechanisms sharing with political and legal organs, government departments, higher education institutions, and technology enterprises, providing strong support for standardizing litigation activities, unifying judgment standards, enriching theoretical research, and promoting social governance.

20. Deepen the disclosure of enforcement information. Optimize and integrate the functions of various enforcement information disclosure platforms, expand the scope of enforcement information disclosure, and promote the centralized and unified disclosure of enforcement case process information, information on persons subject to enforcement, information on the list of discredited persons subject to enforcement, and information on online judicial auctions on the same platform. Strengthen the interface with the social credit system, standardize the methods and mechanisms for disclosing information on discredited persons subject to enforcement, and promote the improvement of a credit punishment pattern where "one is discredited, one is restricted everywhere."

(V) Improve the system for the operation of adjudicative power centered on judicial accountability.

21. Improve the operational mechanism of adjudicative power. Fully implement the principle that "the judge who hears the case makes the judgment, and the one who makes the judgment bears the responsibility," strengthen the legal status of the sole-judge tribunal and the collegiate bench as statutory adjudicative organizations, determine their powers and responsibilities in accordance with the law, and ensure consistency of powers and responsibilities. Comprehensively strengthen the construction of trial teams in basic people's courts. Rationalize the relationships among trial institutions, trial organizations, and trial teams, improve the internal organizational structure, and optimize the allocation of trial resources. Further improve the case allocation mechanism based on "random case assignment as the main rule, designated case assignment as a supplement." In accordance with the categories of trial fields and arrangements for complexity and simplicity分流, improve the mechanism for determining the presiding judge and the chief judge of the collegiate bench.

22. Improve the mechanism for presidents and division chiefs to handle cases on a regular basis. Adhere to the principle that judges who have entered the quota must handle cases, reasonably determine the workload for presidents and division chiefs to handle cases, and work to reduce their non-trial事务 burdens. Scientifically determine the types of cases to be heard by presidents and division chiefs, match them with supporting case allocation mechanisms and allocation models for trial support personnel, ensuring that through hearing cases, presidents and division chiefs can promptly discover and address issues in trial supervision and management and the uniform application of law. Improve the assessment and supervision mechanism for presidents and division chiefs handling cases, supplement it with internal disclosure and regular notification mechanisms, and promote the normalization of case handling by presidents and division chiefs.

23. Improve the adjudicative committee system. Strengthen the macro-guidance functions of the adjudicative committee in summarizing trial experience, unifying the application of law, and studying and discussing major matters in trial work. Improve the mechanism for the adjudicative committee to discuss and decide on issues of law application in major, difficult, and complex cases. Establish a mechanism for reviewing and screening cases proposed to be submitted to the adjudicative committee for discussion. Deepen the transparency of the affairs of the adjudicative committee, and establish a mechanism for publicly disclosing the performance of committee members' duties and matters discussed on the internal office network. Improve the mechanism for publicly disclosing, in accordance with the law, the decisions of the adjudicative committee on the cases discussed and their reasoning in judgment documents. Standardize the composition of the adjudicative committee, and improve the mechanism for senior judges to serve as members of the adjudicative committee. Standardize the scope of persons attending the adjudicative committee meetings and the working procedures.

24. Improve the mechanism for trial supervision and management. Clarify the power list and supervision and management responsibilities of presidents and division chiefs, and improve the mechanisms for guiding the performance of duties and for full traceability of case supervision. Improve the trial supervision mechanism for cases involving petitions, long-term unresolved cases, reversal of judgments on appeal, remand for retrial, retrial upon designation, and retrial upon protest. Through means such as automatic identification by information-based case handling platforms, proactive submission by trial organizations, discovery through performance of duties by presidents and division chiefs, quality assessment of cases by specialized trial management institutions, and proactive acceptance of supervision from parties and society by people's courts, promote the establishment of a comprehensive, scientifically standardized, and law-conforming system of trial supervision and management.

25. Strengthen the standardization of trial processes. Formulate trial process standards covering specialized fields such as criminal, civil, administrative, and state compensation. Standardize the standards for case closure and archiving, and optimize the process for transferring case files. Promote the embedding of work points, time limits, process standards, position guidelines, and document formats from case filing to case closure and archiving into information-based case handling platforms, achieving automated and silent auxiliary functions such as full traceability of completed matters, prompts and reminders for pending matters, regular reminders for matters about to expire, real-time warnings for defective matters, and timely freezing of irregular matters.

26. Improve the mechanism for uniform application of law. Strengthen and standardize judicial interpretation work, improve the mechanisms for research, project initiation, drafting,论证, review, issuance, cleanup, and abolition of judicial interpretations, and refine the mechanisms for centralized management and reporting for review and filing. Improve the system of guiding cases, and refine the mechanisms for case reporting, selection, issuance, evaluation, and application. Establish a mechanism for filing and record-keeping of trial guidance documents and reference cases from higher people's courts. Improve the working linkage mechanism between the presiding judge meeting and the collegiate bench deliberation, the compensation committee, and the adjudicative committee in discussing cases. Improve the mandatory retrieval and reporting mechanism for similar cases and new types of cases.

27. Strengthen the guarantee mechanism for judicial performance of duties. Further improve the protection mechanism for trial and enforcement personnel performing legal duties, the relief and guarantee mechanism for harm suffered, and the mechanism for clarifying false reports. Study and improve systems such as personal accident insurance for court police and staff, strengthen the construction of facilities to guarantee performance of duties, protect and uphold the personal dignity and legitimate rights and interests of court police and staff, and resolutely protect and support those court police and staff who adhere to principles, handle cases impartially, and enforce the law strictly. Study and formulate scientific, reasonable, simple, and easy-to-implement assessment methods for trial performance. Further standardize supervision, inspection, and assessment work, abolish unreasonable and unnecessary assessment indicators, and effectively reduce burdens at the grassroots level and alleviate pressure on police and staff.

28. Improve and perfect the judge disciplinary system. Establish the Judge Disciplinary Committee of the Supreme People's Court, and promote the comprehensive establishment of judge disciplinary committees at the provincial level. Study and formulate relevant provisions on judge discipline, improve the working linkage mechanism with disciplinary inspection and supervision organs, and perfect the working mechanism to guarantee the rights of the judge concerned to make statements, present evidence, defend, raise objections, apply for reconsideration, and file petitions.

(VI) Improve the organizational structure of people's courts and the functional system of institutions.

29. Optimize the functional positioning of the four-level courts. Improve the system of trial levels, fully utilizing their functions of litigation分流, functional stratification, and resource allocation. Strengthen the functions of higher-level courts in supervising and guiding lower-level courts and unifying the application of law. Improve and perfect the mechanisms for transferring jurisdiction and elevating cases for trial, promoting the adjudication of cases with guiding significance for the uniform application of law and concerning public interest by courts at higher levels. Promote the improvement of the system for determining jurisdiction by the amount in controversy in civil and administrative cases. Promote the improvement of procedures and standards for retrial applications in civil and administrative cases, constructing a standardized, fair, and transparent trial supervision system.

30. Deepen the reform of the circuit court system of the Supreme People's Court. Improve the functional positioning and working mechanism of the circuit courts of the Supreme People's Court, and refine comprehensive supporting measures.

31. Standardize the construction of specialized courts. Based on the needs of economic and social development, study and improve the establishment standards, functional positioning, and supporting mechanisms for specialized courts. Strengthen the construction of intellectual property courts, and improve the trial mechanism for patent and other cases. Strengthen the construction of financial courts, improve the financial trial system, and create a good financial legal environment. Strengthen the construction of maritime courts, comprehensively enhancing the international status of China's maritime judiciary.

32. Deepen the reform of internet courts. Further strengthen the construction of internet courts, improve the case jurisdiction and trial system of internet courts. In combination with the business characteristics and technical features of internet courts, transform and optimize the electronic litigation platform, and improve the data interface methods with state organs, relevant institutions, and major e-commerce platforms.

33. Deepen the reform of the judicial jurisdiction system appropriately separated from administrative divisions. Scientifically define the scope and standards for cases under the cross-administrative-regional jurisdiction of people's courts, promoting the formation of a new litigation pattern conducive to breaking the phenomenon of "home and away" in litigation. In coordination with the reform of the organizational system of people's courts, promote the integration of institutions such as railway transport courts, forest area courts, and state farm reclamation area courts, further optimizing the allocation of judicial resources.

34. Deepen the reform of internal institutions of people's courts. Coordinate the promotion of internal institutional reform and the construction of trial and enforcement organizations. Standardize the number, responsibilities, names, and specifications of internal institutions of basic people's courts, optimize work processes, and improve operational quality and efficiency. Based on functions such as political work and party affairs, judicial administration, financial management, and auxiliary事务, set up corresponding institutions comprehensively. Make reasonable use of existing leadership positions, and properly分流 and redeploy cadres. Intermediate people's courts and above, considering their trial level functions, caseload, personnel establishment, etc., optimize the setting of internal institutions, establishing an internal institutional system with clear functional divisions and efficient and smooth operation. Improve the functional positioning of comprehensive business institutions in people's courts.

35. Strengthen the construction of specialized trial mechanisms. Actively promote the reform of environmental resource trial mechanisms, and improve the rules for environmental resource trials. Strengthen the construction of trial mechanisms for finance, liquidation, and bankruptcy, increase the training of trial personnel, and comprehensively enhance the level of specialization. Strengthen the construction of family trial mechanisms, improve and perfect systems such as family mediation, psychological counseling, return visits and support, and study and improve family litigation procedures. Explore the coordinated promotion and development of family trials and juvenile trials.

36. Strengthen the construction of people's tribunals. Further optimize the layout of people's tribunals in urban and rural areas, fully leverage the advantages of people's tribunals in facing the grassroots and the masses, facilitating litigation for the people and facilitating trial by the court, and promote grassroots social governance in accordance with the law. Standardize the number of leadership positions in people's tribunals, strengthen the staffing of people's tribunals, and reasonably ensure the funds needed for people's tribunals to perform their duties normally. Adhere to and improve the circuit trial system of people's tribunals, continuously improving the effectiveness and level of circuit trials.

37. Promote the intensive and socialized management of certain affairs. In coordination with the internal institutional reform, implement intensive management of affairs such as document service, property preservation, enforcement investigation and control, and online announcements within the people's court. Make full use of market-oriented and socialized resources, explore the outsourcing of trial auxiliary affairs and some comprehensive administrative affairs such as online auction assistance, document publication online, distribution of case funds, etc. Improve and perfect the working mechanism for people's courts to purchase socialized services, ensuring that various activities such as public bidding, quality assessment, operational supervision, confidentiality agreements, and business training are legal and compliant, and that the outsourcing mechanism is fair and open.

38. Strengthen the standardization of government affairs in people's courts. Strengthen the standardization of judicial government affairs such as meeting organization, document processing, confidential document handling, and logistical support, promote the integration of government standardization and information technology application, effectively enhance the efficiency and level of judicial government affairs, and provide better services and guarantees for trial and enforcement work.

39. Steadily promote the reform of establishment and personnel management of local courts below the provincial level. Promote the improvement of a system where the organizational establishment of local courts below the provincial level is mainly managed by the provincial organizational establishment department, with the higher people's court coordinating management. Cooperate with relevant departments to improve and perfect the management system for leading cadres of intermediate and basic people's courts.

40. Study and improve the judicial funding guarantee mechanism for people's courts. Study and improve the financial management mechanism, and study the establishment of a dynamic funding adjustment mechanism.

(VII) Improve the litigation system system that conforms to the progress of the times and technological development.

41. Promote the reform of the civil litigation system. Promote the improvement of the litigation fee system. Further improve the mechanism for分流 cases based on complexity and simplicity, improve and perfect the three-dimensional, diversified, and refined litigation procedures, and promote the separation of cases based on complexity and simplicity, severity, and speed. Optimize the application of judicial confirmation procedures. Explore expanding the scope of application of small claims procedures. Further simplify summary procedures, and improve the conversion mechanism between summary procedures and ordinary procedures. Explore promoting the expansion of the scope of application of sole-judge tribunals. Explore the construction of new jurisdictional rules and litigation rules suitable for the needs of the internet era, promoting the deep integration of trial methods and litigation systems with internet technology. Deeply summarize the practical experience of judicial practice, and promote the amendment of the Civil Procedure Law.

42. Promote the reform of the administrative litigation system. Centered on promoting the construction of a law-based government, reform and improve the working mechanism of administrative trials, protect the legitimate rights and interests of private parties subject to administrative actions in accordance with the law, promote the substantive resolution of administrative disputes, and supervise and support administrative organs in exercising their powers according to law. Promote the standardization and legalization of administrative enforcement, serve and guarantee the reform of "delegating powers, improving regulation, and optimizing services." Standardize the jurisdiction mechanism for administrative cases, improve the standards and types of case jurisdiction, and optimize the allocation of administrative trial resources.

43. Promote the reform of the criminal procedure system. Deepen the reform of the criminal procedure system centered on the trial, promote the implementation of the pretrial conference system and the illegal evidence exclusion system, improve the courtroom investigation procedures, implement the system for witnesses, expert witnesses, and investigators to appear in court to testify, implement and improve the rules for the transfer of technical investigation evidence with the case and courtroom investigation, ensuring that the trial plays a substantive role. Standardize the sentencing procedures for guilty plea cases and non-guilty plea cases. Strictly implement the criminal trial by default system and the system for confiscating illegal gains in cases where the defendant absconds or dies, and refine relevant operational provisions. Promote the application of intelligent case handling systems for criminal cases, improve basic evidence guidelines for different stages of criminal proceedings, and cooperate with relevant central departments to embed them into cross-departmental big data case handling platforms. Further support the pilot project of full coverage of lawyer defense in criminal cases, improve the working linkage mechanism, and fully protect the legitimate rights of criminal defense lawyers to practice according to law. Explore the establishment of a system for notifying defense counsel in death penalty review cases, and improve relevant working procedures. Improve the criminal penalty execution system, and promote the unification of the criminal execution system. Promote the improvement of the working mechanism for the delivery and execution of penalties for "ill, disabled, and pregnant" offenders, solving the difficulty in delivering and executing penalties for offenders who were not detained before sentencing. Improve the mechanism for transferring and exiting the execution of property-related parts of criminal judgments. Comprehensively promote the operation of the cross-departmental centralized management information platform for case-related property across the country, and improve the relevant data aggregation and upload mechanisms. Standardize the standards for filing and reviewing criminal petition cases, and improve the procedures and requirements for reviewing criminal petition cases.

44. Improve and perfect the mechanism for serving legal documents in civil and administrative cases. In civil and administrative litigation and enforcement work, comprehensively utilize methods such as electronic service, entrusted service, and agreed service, explore and improve new models of service, and promote the improvement of relevant regulations. Build a unified national electronic service platform, further expanding the scope of legal documents served electronically. Promote the implementation of the system for parties to confirm the address for service. Promote intensive and segmented service work mechanisms, actively explore the use of socialized service methods to carry out service work.

(VIII) Improve the long-term institutional system for effectively solving enforcement difficulties.

45. Promote the improvement and perfection of the comprehensive governance pattern for solving enforcement difficulties. Continuously improve and perfect the comprehensive governance pattern for solving enforcement difficulties featuring "Party committee leadership, political and legal affairs committee coordination, people's congress supervision, government support, court leadership, departmental linkage, and social participation." Promote the inclusion of enforcement work as an important part of social governance innovation and legal construction, and strengthen target responsibility assessment. Promote the establishment of a grassroots assistance enforcement network, fully leveraging the role of comprehensive social governance departments, grassroots organizations, and grid supervisors.

46. Improve the source governance mechanism for effectively addressing difficulties in enforcement. Promote the enactment of a law on compulsory enforcement. Strengthen the certainty and enforceability of effective legal instruments, and establish a mechanism for handling cases where the enforcement content of an effective legal instrument is unclear. Further improve the mechanism for transferring enforcement to bankruptcy, vigorously promote the application of information technology, improve the information exchange and sharing mechanism between enforcement and bankruptcy, promote the swift adjudication of "enforcement-to-bankruptcy" cases, and facilitate the resolution of accumulated enforcement cases. Study and promote the establishment of a personal bankruptcy system and related supporting mechanisms, focusing on resolving cases where enforcement cannot be carried out against individuals. Promote the improvement of company law systems, restrict arbitrary changes of legal representatives and senior management personnel, strengthen company account management, improve the system of full traceability of company transactions, and prevent the arbitrary withdrawal of company assets. Improve the linkage and cooperation mechanism between judicial assistance and social assistance.

47. Deepen the reform of the enforcement system and mechanism. Further promote the reform of the separation of adjudication and enforcement, and optimize the allocation of enforcement power. Implement a judge-centered enforcement team case-handling model, improve the enforcement police support mechanism, and refine the duties and authority limits of various personnel in enforcement procedures. Strengthen the enforcement work mechanism featuring unified management, unified command, and unified coordination. Improve the operation mechanism of the enforcement command center. Promote the separation of complex and simple enforcement cases and enforcement matters, and the implementation of decentralized powers, breaking the case-handling model of "one person handling a case from beginning to end," and effectively enhance the intensive, refined, and standardized level of enforcement work. Improve the coordinated operation mechanism between case filing, trial, and enforcement. Increase the application of litigation preservation, improve the coordination and cooperation mechanism between preservation and enforcement, encourage property preservation insurance guarantees, improve the orderly connection mechanism between preservation applications and enforcement network inquiry and control, and use preservation to promote mediation, settlement, and enforcement.

48. Strengthen the construction of enforcement informatization. Actively apply various new technological means, adhere to the principle of simultaneous development, application, and improvement, optimize and upgrade various enforcement informatization system platforms, further improve the enforcement command system, process node management system, network inquiry and control system, credit punishment system, money and property management system, separate dynamic management system for cases where enforcement is concluded for the time being, and enforcement petition handling system. Deepen the reform of asset pricing and disposal models centered on online judicial auction, improve the online evaluation and auction system, and establish an online inquiry and evaluation system. Improve the integrated enforcement case-handling platform for courts at four levels, strengthen node control, and realize the informatization and intelligentization of case management. Build a mobile case-handling platform that meets the characteristics of enforcement implementation work, effectively improving work efficiency and management level. Promote the application of intelligent assistance and big data analysis technology to reduce the workload of enforcement personnel.

49. Strengthen the standardization and normalization of enforcement. Establish and improve a system of norms for enforcement actions centered on operating procedures, and improve the standardized and normalized processes for various procedural nodes and enforcement actions. Improve the mechanisms for coordinated enforcement and entrusted enforcement, and standardize the initiation and approval procedures for designated enforcement, elevation of enforcement, and cross-regional enforcement. Strictly regulate the procedures for concluding, resuming, and exiting cases where there is no property available for enforcement, and comprehensively implement centralized and dynamic management of cases where enforcement is concluded for the time being.

50. Further strengthen the intensity of compulsory enforcement. Continuously expand the scope of network inquiry and control, strengthen the functions of freezing and deduction, and promote the full coverage of all types of property by the network inquiry and control system. Further improve the property reporting system for persons subject to enforcement, and increase the punishment for persons subject to enforcement who refuse to report, make false reports, or report property overdue without justifiable reasons. Improve working mechanisms such as entrusted auditing, entrusted investigation, and reward for reporting, and strengthen supervision over major asset disposals and important matter changes by persons subject to enforcement or persons assisting in enforcement. Closely cooperate with relevant parties, comprehensively promote information sharing, improve the credit supervision, warning, and punishment system for dishonest persons subject to enforcement, and promote the formation of a new normal of multi-departmental, multi-industry, multi-field, and multi-means joint credit punishment. Fully apply compulsory enforcement measures such as fines, detention, and restriction on exit in accordance with the law, and increase the punishment for acts of resisting enforcement, obstructing enforcement, and violent defiance of the law. Improve the anti-circumvention enforcement working mechanism, and severely crack down on criminal acts of refusing to enforce judgments or rulings in accordance with the law.

(9) Improve the system for classified management of court personnel and occupational security

51. Improve the dynamic adjustment mechanism for staffing. Improve the overall management and dynamic adjustment mechanism for special political and legal staffing, and promote the inclination of special political and legal staffing towards areas with prominent personnel-case conflicts and primary people's courts by provincial-level staffing authorities in conjunction with the Higher People's Courts. Adjust and optimize the layout structure of existing special political and legal staffing in people's courts of each province (autonomous region, municipality directly under the Central Government).

52. Improve the classified management system for court personnel. Improve the management system for judge posts, improve the mechanisms for judge exchange and withdrawal, and clarify the circumstances, procedures, corresponding consequences, and remedies for withdrawal, to achieve normalization and institutionalization of post entry and exit. Improve the personnel exchange mechanism and talent cultivation mechanism in comprehensive business departments of people's courts. Improve the training, assessment, cultivation, and selection mechanisms for judicial support personnel, and build a professional team of judicial support personnel. Based on the functional characteristics of people's courts and in conjunction with the parallel system of civil service positions and ranks, establish and improve internal job exchange mechanisms, and broaden the career development paths for judicial support personnel and judicial administrative personnel.

53. Improve the mechanism for selecting and appointing judges. Cooperate with relevant departments to uniformly standardize the establishment and functions of judge selection committees. Promote and strengthen the professional gatekeeping function of judge selection committees, appropriately increase the proportion of legal professionals, standardize selection criteria and procedures, and promote the establishment of a selection mechanism combining regularity and flexibility to ensure timely replenishment of vacant posts. Improve the selection criteria and working mechanism for selecting judges from qualified judge assistants, and establish a corresponding training mechanism for newly appointed judges that adapts to the functional characteristics of local courts and specialized courts. Improve the supporting measures for the system of hierarchical selection of judges. Further improve the working mechanism for openly selecting judges from among lawyers, experts and scholars, and other legal professionals.

54. Improve supporting measures for the independent job sequence for judges. Study and formulate regulations on the independent job sequence for judges, measures for setting the ratio of judge ranks, and measures for the promotion and demotion of judge ranks, promote the formation of a normalized mechanism for regular promotion and merit-based promotion of judge ranks, and implement the policy orientation favoring basic-level people's courts. Improve the working mechanism for selecting leading cadres of people's courts from among qualified judges. Coordinate with relevant departments to clarify the supporting living treatment guarantee system corresponding to the independent job sequence for judges.

55. Improve the treatment guarantee mechanism for court personnel. Comprehensively implement the reform of the wage system for court personnel, and improve the salary distribution mechanism closely linked to the actual work performance of judges. Promote the implementation of a normal adjustment mechanism for the basic salary standard of judges, and adjust the basic salary standard of judges correspondingly when the basic salary standard of other civil servants is adjusted. Improve the occupational security policies for judicial support personnel and judicial administrative personnel.

56. Improve the mechanism for staffing judicial support personnel. Improve the mode and standards for staffing judicial support personnel in courts at different levels. While adhering to standardized recruitment and strict selection, explore effective measures suitable for recruiting judge assistants in city and county level courts, and implement the preferential policies of the Party Central Committee for civil service recruitment in hard and remote areas. Explore the establishment of a working mechanism for judges from lower people's courts to be exchanged to higher people's courts to serve as short-term judge assistants. Improve the recruitment and management mechanism for contract-based court clerks. Further strengthen the building of a professional team of judicial technical personnel. Establish and improve a normalized mechanism for law school students to intern at people's courts.

57. Promote the reform of the management system for judicial police. Further implement the requirements for unit management, and establish a management system that conforms to the characteristics of judicial police work. Promote the improvement of relevant legal systems for judicial police. Promote the reform of the job sequence for judicial police performing law enforcement and service duties, and further promote the establishment of a convenient recruitment mechanism for judicial police and a police supervision system. Improve the management mechanism for police auxiliary personnel. Actively promote the informatization of judicial police work.

58. Improve the education and training mechanism for court personnel. Improve the education and training system for all types of personnel in people's courts, focusing on improving the ability to apply laws and policies, the ability to prevent and control risks, the ability to work with the public, the ability to apply technology, and the ability to guide public opinion, and establish a lifelong learning system covering their professional careers. Improve the regular training mechanism for judges to ensure that each judge participates in at least one full-time professional training session per year and no less than 10 days of professional training per year. Improve the construction of a pool of trainers for judge education and training. Persist in the normalization and openness of online video training, promote the construction of "cloud classrooms," build a good online boutique course library, and improve relevant supporting measures. Improve the training mechanism for bilingual judges in ethnic minority areas. Improve the system for two-way exchanges between people's courts and law schools and research institutions.

59. Improve the supporting system for the management of people's assessors. Implement the People's Assessors Law, and refine issues such as the scope of cases in which people's assessors participate, court trial procedures, and deliberation rules. Improve the management measures for the selection, training, assessment, rewards, and punishments of people's assessors. Improve the system and regulations, and promote the improvement of the funding guarantee system for people's assessors to perform their duties.

60. Improve the national court organizational and personnel system. Establish a unified, efficient, and standardized information management platform that supports data sharing and interoperability with various business platforms of people's courts, realize the sharing of personnel, case, and government affairs information, and promote the systematization and professionalization of the national court personnel management system.

(10) Build a modern smart court application system

61. Deepen the construction of smart court infrastructure. Build a full-element integrated information infrastructure supported by cloud computing. Improve the configuration level of information infrastructure in national courts, the performance of court special networks, and network security defense capabilities. Optimize and integrate various office and case-handling platforms to avoid duplicate construction and idle waste. Promote the establishment of a cross-department big data case-handling platform to achieve interconnection of case-handling systems, automatic data push, and resource sharing. Establish a security protection system for key information infrastructure of people's courts, and plan, build, and use a hierarchical security protection system simultaneously.

62. Promote the deep application of technological innovation means. Comprehensively improve the effectiveness of voice recognition technology in court trial voice transcription, build a national court intelligent voice cloud platform, and achieve model sharing and unified management of voice recognition in national courts. Strengthen the construction of software and infrastructure for remote video trials, remote interrogations, and digital court appearances, reducing travel time for case handling. Strengthen the construction of intelligent auxiliary case-handling systems, and improve functions such as similar case push, result comparison, data analysis, and defect prompts. Further improve the integrated online data processing mechanism for disputes such as road traffic accidents.

63. Systematically expand the coverage of electronic litigation. Fully utilize the first-mover advantage of the popularization and application of mobile Internet in China, and further increase the coverage, application proportion, and application level of electronic litigation in national courts. Gradually achieve the coverage of three types of applications—online case filing, online payment, and electronic service—across all national courts, building a world-leading mobile litigation service system.

64. Improve the mechanism for generating and archiving electronic case files. Improve the technical support and operation management mechanism for the simultaneous generation of electronic case files with cases, to achieve the nationwide coverage of applications such as electronic case files being simultaneously uploaded to the case-handling system, automatic cataloging of electronic case files, remote access to original trial case files, assisted generation of litigation documents, and intelligent push of similar cases. Gradually promote the adoption of a case archiving method primarily based on electronic archives and supplemented by paper archives. Establish a unified national electronic archive management system.

65. Improve the management and application mechanism of judicial big data. Enrich and expand judicial data resources, conduct in-depth research on judicial big data, and continuously improve the level of data aggregation, analysis, and application. Strengthen the application of big data in judicial management and clean justice. Focusing on the overall situation of economic and social development, explore the construction of a judicial social governance index, deeply reveal the intrinsic connection between trial and enforcement activities and economic and social development, and provide reference for scientific decision-making.

III. Organizational Implementation

To comprehensively deepen the comprehensive supporting reforms of the judicial system, we must strengthen organizational leadership, reinforce primary responsibilities, make scientific and thorough arrangements, and properly manage public opinion and ideological work, to ensure the full implementation of all reform measures. People's courts at all levels must translate the requirement of being politically conscious into concrete actions to advance reforms. They should enhance their political stance, strengthen their political responsibility, treat resolute implementation of the Party Central Committee's reform plans as a litmus test for maintaining high alignment with the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, regard whether the advancement of reforms is solid and effective as an important criterion for testing the strength of the "Four Consciousnesses," and implement reform measures with the spirit of driving nails to ensure they take effect and produce results. This will ensure that reforms proceed steadily and persistently, and that the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case.

Strengthen organizational leadership. The Judicial Reform Leading Group of the Supreme People's Court shall be responsible for the overall coordination, implementation, supervision, and evaluation of the tasks outlined in this Outline. By establishing ledgers, managing outstanding accounts, tracking supervision, and holding accountability through inspection, it will ensure the reform tasks are advanced with focus, steps, and order. All Higher People's Courts, the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army, and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region shall improve their judicial reform leading groups and their working bodies, and play a role in overall coordination, organization and implementation, and supervision and guidance. For pilot projects to be carried out on major reform projects, the pilot plan must be submitted to the Supreme People's Court for approval. Major reform pilot projects deployed by the Central Committee must be submitted by the Supreme People's Court to the Central Committee for approval before implementation. People's courts at all levels shall improve the systems for reporting, filing, and seeking instructions on major issues and matters in judicial reform, timely summarize reform experiences, report work progress, and reflect on issues and difficulties.

Reinforce primary responsibilities. The top priority shall be to improve the quality of plans, complete tasks on time, and ensure work implementation. It is necessary to strengthen the decomposition of reform tasks, clarify the timetable, road map, responsible persons, and task books for each reform item one by one, ensuring that each task is monitored and managed by someone. We must strengthen the supervision and effectiveness evaluation of reform implementation, promote the expansion and deepening of reform supervision, and investigate thoroughly. We must broaden the channels for policy interpretation, by distributing Q&A materials, compiling policy readers, and organizing special training sessions, to clearly explain reform policies, and guide court personnel to understand, support, and participate in reforms.

Make scientific and thorough arrangements. It is necessary to fully grasp the relationship between basing ourselves on the present and planning for the long term. In terms of logic, focus on orderly connection; in terms of results, focus on consolidation and improvement; in terms of supporting measures, focus on systematic integration. This will ensure that various reform measures are tightly interlocked, and that the effects of reforms are expanded in a rolling manner, maximizing the institutional effects and overall impact of the reforms. Following the path of "old pilot sites leading new ones" and "good role models acting as good teachers," we should sort out the experience and methods of pioneers, give full play to the exemplary role of those who are good at succeeding, regularly compile and print judicial reform cases, actively promote grassroots innovative measures, and promote the sustainable development of reform measures.

Strengthen public opinion guidance. We must insist on simultaneously formulating reform plans and publicity and public opinion work plans, and advancing reform implementation and publicity and public opinion guidance simultaneously. We must actively adapt to the laws of communication in the Internet age, deeply publicize the good experiences and results of the people's courts in deepening the comprehensive supporting reforms of the judicial system, by optimizing publicity platforms and innovating publicity methods, tell the story of judicial reform in the people's courts, and give the people a greater sense of gain.
